title: Kitzbüheler Hornbahn
highlights: Cable car up to the prominent Kitzbüheler Horn
Magnificent panoramic view of Wilder Kaiser and Glockner group
Alpine Flower Garden featuring over 400 rare high-altitude plants
Ideal starting point for mountain hikes and via ferratas
kurzbeschreibung: The Kitzbüheler Hornbahn comfortably transports mountain enthusiasts to the striking Kitzbüheler Horn, featuring fascinating views and an alpine flower garden.
beschreibung:
Mountain Experience at the Kitzbüheler Horn

The Kitzbüheler Hornbahn provides access to one of the most famous panoramic mountains in the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Starting from Kitzbühel, the cable car ascends in several sections into high alpine elevations. At the summit, an incomparable 360-degree panorama unfolds, ranging from the striking Wilder Kaiser across the Leoganger Steinberge to the glaciated peaks of the Hohe Tauern.

Alpine Flower Garden and Nature Trails

Right at the mountain station, the lovingly landscaped alpine flower garden invites exploration, showcasing hundreds of thriving alpine plant species. Numerous well-marked hiking trails and attractive via ferratas offer diverse routes for families as well as ambitious mountaineers. Rustic alpine huts and mountain restaurants ensure traditional Tyrolean hospitality and delightful culinary stops.
